test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question: In MS-Excel 365 which of the following appears across the top of the screen and below the title bar and contains all the commands, formulas and features needed to create data-intense spreadsheets?
solution:
__
 
• A ribbon is a set of tools that are found on the top of the window in the MS Office suite.

 
 
• This provides the tools for changing the format of the document.
 
 
 
• This gives the extra space to view the document.
 
 
• To expand or collapse the **ribbon**, double-click on any of the tab names on the top.
 
 
 
• You can also use the shortcut CTRL + F1 to do it. Hence option 1 is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** CTRL + F2 shortcut displays the print preview. To access it without a shortcut:

 
• Go to the File tab, and click the print option, there you can find the print preview box.

 
• ALT + F1 shortcut creates an embedded chart of the data in the current range.
 
• ALT + F2 shortcut opens the "Save As" dialog box to save the workbook in a specific location.
 
• In MS-Excel 365, the Ribbon appears across the top of the screen and below the title bar, and it contains all the commands, formulas, and features needed to create data-intense spreadsheets.
 
• The Ribbon is organized into tabs, such as Home, Insert, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, and View, each of which contains groups of related commands.
 
• By clicking on a tab, you can access the commands and features related to that tab.
 
• The Ribbon is customizable, which means you can add or remove commands and create your own custom tabs to suit your specific needs.
